subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: What user-visible context-overflow details should OpenClaw show by default across Discord and other channel sessions?
rationale: The code already computes or logs many requested facts, but choosing raw versus redacted session/channel labels and token/model details is a user-facing privacy and UX policy decision.

options.title: Approve redacted diagnostics
options.body: Show provider/model, effective context budget, measured or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted conversation label through one shared formatter.

options.title: Keep details operator-only
options.body: Leave channel replies generic and improve `/status`, logs, and docs for operators who need detailed diagnostics.

options.title: Split narrow and broad visibility
options.body: Fix only terminal overflow error details here and leave proactive warnings, compaction notifications, and status footers to broader context-visibility work.

recommendation.title: Approve redacted diagnostics
recommendation.body: Show provider/model, effective context budget, measured or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted conversation label through one shared formatter.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete most recently carried the affected embedded runner and user-visible error-copy paths and already commented on this issue's prior review.
